in_marathi.name: Venktesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Fort
in_marathi.long_meaning: Venktesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Venktesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Venkata', which means 'hill' and 'Sesha', which means 'the last one'. The name Venktesh is a combination of these two words and refers to Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted sitting on a hill and is the last among the Gods. It is believed that the name Venktesh bestows strength, courage, and victory upon the bearer.
